question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **remains**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **'Remains'** mean the parts left over after other parts have been removed, used, or destroyed (अवशेष).

 
 
• **Example: **Archaeologists often study the remains of ancient civilizations to learn about their cultures.
